analysis:
The supplied changes are documentation only. docs/architecture/inference.md adds a prompt-chunk attention row at about line 850 for fused causal prefill, and docs/reference/configuration.md adds a DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL row at line 313. The other inference.md units (lines 1227-1778) are unchanged context. No executable code, authorization, attestation, encryption or wire-protocol surface is touched, so no regression against the threat model could be identified from the supplied evidence.

The documented behavior changes how prompt chunks are computed: a single fused `.causal` SDPA call replaces 128-query blocks when the head geometry is eligible. That is an attention-kernel and performance path inside TB-007. Live packed paged KV keeps its own path. The documented gating excludes windowed, softcap, vision-span and bidirectional-mask attention.

The source change in AttentionV1.swift and PagedLayerCache.swift is not in this batch, so I could not verify it. Open questions for a deeper pass on the code:
- Does the fused causal path preserve the prefix-cache and KV-write semantics that T-041 relies on? Examples are the paged write dtype validation latch and whether cached blocks stay byte-identical, so cache identity and HMAC names are unaffected.
- Does it add any timing difference that widens the existing SEC-035 TTFT oracle? That channel is already accepted.
- Do mask semantics stay correct for cross-request isolation in batched prefill (A-001)?

The env var is read once per process and, per the doc, is not forwarded to LaunchAgents. It is a local operator control and not a coordinator-controlled input. No new finding. The threat model does not need updating from these doc edits alone.
